step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify the user actor (PF.AE) connecting to the Application Load Balancer (ALB).
2. Trace ALB routing web traffic to EC2 Spot instances running Kubernetes pods within EKS across multiple availability zones.
3. Trace the spot termination lifecycle: a terminating EC2 Spot instance sends an event to EventBridge.
4. EventBridge triggers a Lambda function to handle auto-scaling and node draining.
